# Isaiah Chapter 13 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 22 verses]*

*Cosmic judgment; stars/sun/moon darkened; Medes against Babylon; like Sodom and Gomorrah*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** The day of the LORD is coming — cruel, with wrath and fierce anger. This chapter cosmic judgment.

*-- LOGOS*
